objective: Deliver Pattern A integration with deterministic concurrent merge behavior
summary: Implement CWSO-backed concurrent execution with clear ownership boundaries, validation gates, and rollout capture hooks.

tasks.title: Wire CWSO MCP client adapter
acceptance_criteria: Adapter can authenticate and call create_shadow_workspace
Error handling maps transport failures to structured diagnostics

tasks.title: Implement deterministic merge orchestration
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent worker edits are merged with stable ordering
Unresolved conflicts include structured reason and path

tasks.title: Add integration validation gate
acceptance_criteria: Functional tests assert success and conflict outcomes
Gate emits PASS or FAIL verdict with evidence

risks: Role-to-tool permission mismatches can block merge operations
